title: Mythos Era - BOD 26-04 Prioritization + EA Visibility (ES 8.8)
description: Part 1: CISA BOD 26-04 risk-based patch prioritization (real scanned servers). Part 2: Exposure Analytics visibility - shadow assets, unscanned servers, missing EDR.

input_hunt_target.title: 2. Or type host / IP (any = use list)

| where priority_label="P1" | stats count

| where priority_label="P3" | stats count

| inputlookup ea_network_asset_inventory | lookup asm_exposed_assets.csv nt_host OUTPUT external_ip | eval typed=lower(trim("$hunt_target$")), t=if(in(typed,"any","*",""), lower("$hunt_pick$"), typed) | eval allids=",".mvjoin(mvappend(lower(nt_host), ip, ip_translated, external_ip), ",")."," | where like(allids, "%,".t.",%") | head 1 | eval Host=nt_host, ip=mvindex(ip,0), edr=if(isnotnull(lastseen_05),"yes","no"), cmdb=if(isnotnull(lastseen_14) OR isnotnull(lastseen_15),"yes","no") | lookup asset_business_context.csv nt_host OUTPUT bunit owner priority | join type=left Host [| savedsearch "BOD 26-04 Vulnerability Prioritization" | stats values(cve) AS cves values(kev_product) AS products min(priority_label) AS tier max(eval(if(forensic_required="yes",1,0))) AS f min(clock_start) AS clock_start by Host] | eval forensic=if(f=1,"yes","no"), cves=mvjoin(cves,", "), products=mvjoin(products,", "), bunit=coalesce(bunit,"unknown"), owner=coalesce(owner,"unassigned"), priority=coalesce(priority,"unknown") | table Host ip external_ip edr cmdb bunit owner priority tier forensic cves products clock_start | rename Host as Host, ip as IP, external_ip as "External IP", edr as EDR, cmdb as "In CMDB", bunit as "Business Unit", owner as Owner, priority as "Asset Priority", tier as "BOD Tier", forensic as "Forensic Triage", cves as CVEs, products as Products, clock_start as "Clock Start"

options.markdown: MYTHOS ERA - RISK-BASED VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT | CISA BOD 26-04 x SPLUNK ENTERPRISE SECURITY 8.8 EXPOSURE ANALYTICS
# Vulnerability Risk - Prioritize the Known, Expose the Unknown

## PART 1 - BOD 26-04 Patch Prioritization (scanned servers)
Rank every scanner finding by **Exposed x KEV x Automatable x Impact** (not CVSS) -> **P1** 3 days (+ forensics) | **P2** 14 days | **P3** 60 days | **P4** next upgrade

options.underLabel: BOD 26-04: In KEV + total control + exposed or automatable

severity_table.title: The old way - CVSS severity alone

sla_pie.title: SLA posture - are we on time?

options.markdown:
### Prioritized worklist
Filter: tier **$sel_priority$** | SLA **$sel_sla$** | EDR **$sel_edr$** | KEV **$sel_kev$** | Exposed **$sel_exposed$** - sorted P1-first, earliest deadline on top.

## PART 2 - Exposure Analytics: what the funnel does NOT govern
The scanner can't rank what it doesn't see -> find **shadow assets**, **unscanned servers**, **hosts without EDR** -> register, scan, protect

options.underLabel: Observed on network, absent from CMDB

shadow_table.title: 2.1 Shadow assets - alive on the network, nobody registered them
shadow_table.description: Not in CMDB. Sorted by risk: P1 + exposed first. Fix = register owner, scan, patch. Follows the global filters: Priority Tier, Exposed, Asset Priority, EDR, In KEV.

unscanned_table.title: 2.2 Servers outside VA coverage - risk unmeasured
unscanned_table.description: No current vulnerability scan, so zero findings. Exposed servers first. Fix = scan. Follows the global filters: Priority Tier, Exposed, Asset Priority, EDR, In KEV.

options.markdown: Sources: Tenable findings (aligned to EA Tenable-scanned servers) x ea_network_asset_inventory (live EA) x asm_exposed_assets (ASM) x CISA KEV (index=cisa_kev) x CISA Vulnrichment SSVC (index=cisa_vuln) via TA-Vulnerability catalog | Tiers & clock: CISA BOD 26-04 Table 1 / Appendix A

noedr_table.title: 2.3 No endpoint security - no EDR telemetry, no way to detect or contain
noedr_table.description: No CrowdStrike (EA source 05). Sorted by risk: P1 + exposed first. Fix = deploy EDR. Follows the global filters: Priority Tier, Exposed, Asset Priority, EDR, In KEV.

options.markdown:
## PART 3 - AI Hunting & Forensic Triage (AITK Agent + Splunk MCP)
Pick a P1 + forensic host -> signals from web, host and network logs -> **Hunting** agent returns the triage verdict and whether to escalate a case

hunt_ctx_table.title: 3.1 Target - what we know before hunting

hunt_ai_table.title: 3.3 AI agent triage report - ATT&CK hypothesis, evidence matrix, verdict
hunt_ai_table.description: Set 'Run AI agent' = Yes. The agent builds an ATT&CK attack-path hypothesis from KEV + Vulnrichment, tests it with CIM data-model hunt templates and returns the verdict, evidence matrix, gaps and leads.

hunt_intel_table.title: 3.2 Threat intel for this host - CISA KEV + Vulnrichment + scanner (the agent's hunt hypothesis)
hunt_intel_table.description: Product, weakness (CWE), attack vector and port tell the agent where and what to hunt. KEV first.
